facts.fact: Cabinet spokesperson Cornelius Mweetwa described the Data Protection Act No. 3 of 2021 as the existing law that established a foundation for protecting personal data.
Cabinet approved in principle, at its 8th meeting, introducing a Bill in Parliament to repeal the 2021 Act and cover non-personal, industrial and public data, per Mweetwa.
facts.system: Bill repealing Data Protection Act No. 3 of 2021
